song_craft: Voice: stotra couplets, one work-voice across fifteen rasa-colors (adbhuta→vīra→śṛṅgāra→ānanda→śānta — the work walks the rasas home to peace). Each verse hammer-tight in L3: L4 = L3 verbatim throughout, music named per verse. Arc: all-containing light (v1) → aloneness (v2) → inseparables (v3) → mirror-bearing (v4) → exact fullness (v5) → play at once (v6) → five-in-one (v7) → criterion (v8) → abiding change (v9) → total inventory (v10) → bondage named (v11) → open doors (v12) → release (v13) → non-difference (v14) → dwelling enjoined (v15).

lines: What is hardest to do is His — and none is higher;
that itself is freedom, lordship, awareness-nature.
l4.sanskrit_cite: atidurghaṭakāritvam asyānuttaram eva yat | etad eva svatantratvam aisvaryaṃ bodharūpatā

verses.craft: Five-said-once equation kept whole (hardest=unsurpassed=freedom=lordship=awareness); rank-reading per UNC.
verses.rejected: (a) trimming list → killed: equation is content. (b) awareness-form→consciousness → killed: L3 frozen term.
